name: Yonex Voctric Z-Force II white ( Master Copy )
description:
Yonex Nanoflare Z-Force II Badminton Racket

Brand: Yonex
Model: Nanoflare Z-Force II
Type: Badminton Racket Bat
Flex: Stiff
Shaft: H.M. Graphite with NANOMETRIC technology
Frame: H.M. Graphite, NANOMETRIC DR, Ni-Ti Fiber
Weight / Grip Size:

3U: Avg. 88g (G4, G5)

2U: Avg. 93g (G4, G5)
Stringing Advice:

3U: 16–26 lbs

2U: 20–27 lbs
Balance: Head-light / Fast swing (suitable for attacking play)
Features:

Ultra-stiff shaft for maximum smash power

Advanced frame technology for stability and durability

Lightweight design for quick reflexes and fast gameplay

Ideal for intermediate to professional players

Highlights:

Perfect for fast, attacking style badminton

Delivers precision, speed, and powerful smashes

Ergonomic handle for comfortable grip
